content: where $\frac{\partial {F(\textbf {x})_n}}{\partial {\textbf {x}_m}}$ is the gradient of $F(\textbf {x})_n$ w.r.t. the embedding of the $m^{th}$ word. In this paper, as suggested, the baseline input $\textbf {x}^{\prime }$ is set as a sequence of zero embeddings that has the same sequence length $M$. In this way, we can compute the contribution of a specific input word to a designated output word. Since the above formula is intractable for deep neural models, we approximate it by summing the gradients along a multi-step path from baseline $\textbf {x}^{\prime }$ to the input x.
